About Queen Creek & San Tan Valley

Growing Communities

Queen Creek and San Tan Valley rank among Arizona's fastest-growing areas:

  • Young families
  • New developments
  • Agricultural heritage
  • Community events

Location

Southeast Valley location:

  • 35 miles from Phoenix Sky Harbor
  • 25 miles from Mesa Gateway
  • Access via US-60 and AZ-24

Transportation Services

Airport Connections

Two airport options for residents:

  • Phoenix Sky Harbor: Full airline service
  • Mesa Gateway: Growing options, shorter drive

Professional transfers to both airports with flight monitoring and luggage assistance.

Commuter Services

Daily commute options for:

  • Corporate employees
  • Executive schedules
  • Medical appointments
  • Business meetings

Event Transportation

  • Schnepf Farms events
  • Queen Creek Olive Mill
  • San Tan Mountain Regional Park
  • Local school events

Schnepf Farms Transportation

Seasonal Events

  • Pumpkin & Chili Party (fall)
  • Country Thunder (spring)
  • Peach Festival (summer)
  • Christmas events

Festival transportation avoids parking hassles and provides comfortable group travel.

Pricing

  • Airport transfer (Sky Harbor or Mesa Gateway): from $225 one way in the Luxury SUV (up to 6) or $295 in the Executive Black Sprinter (up to 14), flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included
  • Schnepf Farms outings and events: hourly with a 4-hour minimum, $500 in the Luxury SUV, $580 in the Executive Black Sprinter or $700 in the Limo Party Sprinter (up to 16)

Prices are before 8% Arizona sales tax. Every rate is on the pricing page.
